# Wave Solution Cleaning & Pest Control

> Wave Solution provides residential, rental, office, commercial and specialist cleaning services across the Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia, with pest control services also available.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.wavesolution.com.au/): Overview of services, service areas and booking options.
- [Services](https://www.wavesolution.com.au/services): Service directory.
- [Book a clean](https://www.wavesolution.com.au/book): Request a quote and provide job details.
- [Contact](https://www.wavesolution.com.au/contact): Contact details and enquiry form.
- [Service areas](https://www.wavesolution.com.au/locations): Gold Coast locations served.
- [About Wave Solution](https://www.wavesolution.com.au/about): Business information.
- [Customer feedback](https://www.wavesolution.com.au/testimonials): Customer feedback page.
- [Cleaning guides](https://www.wavesolution.com.au/blog): Cleaning and rental guides.

## Service area

Gold Coast, Southport, Surfers Paradise, Broadbeach, Robina, Nerang, Burleigh Heads, Palm Beach, Helensvale, Coomera, Varsity Lakes, Carrara, Merrimac, Main Beach, Benowa and Highland Park.
